'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jonny Chu LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jonathan Chu
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
